title: PhysMLLMs: Spatial Priors for Unified Referring Segmentation and Grounded Reasoning of Images and Videos
abstract: arXiv:2608.24574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Video multimodal large language models support language guided video segmentation, but they often show spatio temporal inconsistencies, e.g., jitter, drift, and identity switches. These failures are more common when targets are partly hidden or when similar objects appear nearby.One likely reason is that current training lacks explicit spatial priors, which makes it difficult to maintain stable spatial identity and shape over time. We present PhysMLLMs, a training-stage prior injection architecture that injects physics-inspired spatial continuity priors into Video MLLMs. PhysMLLMs is designed to encourage more stable object-centered representations by aligning the student global visual representation with a frozen teacher model during training. translated_title: PhysMLLMs：用于图像与视频统一指代分割及基于空间先验的接地推理的空间先验方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24574v1 公告类型：新 摘要：视频多模态大语言模型支持语言引导的视频分割，但往往表现出时空不一致性，例如抖动、漂移和身份切换。当目标部分被遮挡或附近出现相似物体时，这些失败更为常见。一个可能的原因是当前训练缺乏显式的空间先验，这使得在时间上难以维持稳定的空间身份和形状。我们提出了PhysMLLMs，一种训练阶段的先验注入架构，将物理启发的空间连续性先验注入视频多模态大语言模型。PhysMLLMs旨在通过训练期间将学生全局视觉表示与冻结的教师模型对齐，促进更稳定的对象中心表示。我们的核心机制——全局表示先验对齐（REPA-Global），使用离线嵌入缓存和调度蒸馏，从冻结的DINOv2教师模型中蒸馏全局视觉表示。
tldr: 通过注入物理启发的空间先验和对齐全局视觉表示，PhysMLLMs显著提升了视频多模态大语言模型在指代分割中的时空一致性。
en_tdlr: PhysMLLMs enhances spatio-temporal consistency in video multimodal LLMs for referring segmentation by injecting physics-inspired spatial priors and aligning global visual representations.
